subject: environmental-science
title: Renewable Energy: Pros & Cons
welcome_lead: Renewables are clean — but every choice has trade-offs.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: advantages and disadvantages of renewables.
final_note: No energy is perfect, but renewables are getting better all the time.

concepts.def: Comes and goes — like wind and sun.
Money needed to build or run something.
How much ground a power source takes.
Batteries or dams that hold energy for later.

walkthroughs.body_html: Renewables are carbon free in use, don't run out, and fuel is free. Long-term they cut bills and pollution.
Wind and solar are intermittent. Big farms use land or sea space. Building turbines and panels needs raw materials.
Batteries and pumped-hydro storage save energy for calm or cloudy days. Smart grids share power across regions.
